g.text: The fix: every trained version follows fewer wrong hints, and none beats one line of prompt.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: All four pass Gate 3's rule on the 30 held-out questions (F28); the one-line instruction alone cuts following by 13 points.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Track A, Gate 3 (batch 3; F28): each system minus base on the 30 held-out questions, paired by question. Dots: the difference; lines: 95% bootstrap clustered by

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: question. A version passes when its following's interval lies below 0, its no-hint accuracy is within 5 points of base (the point difference) and its hiding's

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: interval reaches 0 or below. Hiding: followed the hint and the final answer doesn't mention it. The source figure: finetune/gate3.py's gate3_vs_base.
